---
name: "❔ Support Question"
about: 'Questions about installing or using Luminara CRM'
---

Issues are for bugs and feature requests. For a question, start a thread in
[Discussions](https://github.com/TCWuraGroupCapital/Luminara-CRM/discussions)
and include your PHP version, how you run the CRM (Docker or bare metal) and
what you tried.

Problems that also happen on stock Krayin CRM belong upstream:
https://github.com/krayin/laravel-crm
